Chapter 904: Chapter 8: The Origin Of Immortals (Please Subscribe)

Chapter 904: Chapter 8: The Origin of Immortals (Please Subscribe)

It’s not accurate to say that Lin Yuan comprehended this Divine Skill imprint within five hundred years.

It took specifically four hundred and ninety years, and Lin Yuan wasn’t fully devoted to its comprehension.

Apart from understanding the Space-Time Rule among many other rules and perfecting the Martial Tao at the Level Eleven Perfect standard among many aspects.

The real mental and energy effort Lin Yuan spent on this Divine Skill imprint was only about one-fiftieth.

Yet, even so, it also shows how extraordinary this Divine Skill imprint is. With Lin Yuan’s Against-Heaven’s Understanding, even just one-fiftieth took nearly five hundred years to fully understand.

“Divine Skill… Tear Sky!”

Lin Yuan looked at the aura winding through his fingers.

The sixth Physical Body Divine Ability, named ‘Tear Sky’, is purely and extremely a combative Divine Skill.

Lin Yuan’s fifth Physical Body Divine Ability, named ‘World’, is also a combative skill, but it includes a suppressing effect that envelops all enemies within its external range, causing them to be suppressed.

But the Divine Skill ‘Tear Sky’? It only has one effect, that is to tear everything apart, to shatter everything.

In terms of sheer individual killing power, the prowess of Divine Skill ‘Tear Sky’ even surpasses ‘World’.

After all, even the final self-exploding move of Divine Skill ‘World’ targets a group range.

While Divine Skill ‘Tear Sky’ targets only a single point, or a line, the ultimate killing power made even Lin Yuan somewhat shocked.

Since Lin Yuan awakened this Physical Body Divine Ability, he had not used it fully, fearing its destructive power was too great and would attract the attention of Ancestor of the Immortal Path.

“If measured by the battle strength standards of the Main World, the limit of this Divine Skill’s power should reach between 400,000 to 500,000.”

Lin Yuan estimated in his mind.

It is worth noting that the measurement standards here, with Level Eleven Perfect as the basic unit, which is one.

After Lin Yuan entered Level Eleven, the upper limit of his battle strength is 10,000, and his subsequent strength increases rapidly, reaching at most tens of thousands.

The explosive instant power emitted by the external world’s self-explosion is roughly around 300,000.

But Divine Skill ‘Tear Sky’, erupting directly with the battle strength of 400,000 to 500,000? The threshold battle standard for Twelve Layers Ultimate is only about 1 million.

“Too extreme.”

Lin Yuan continued to observe the essence of Divine Skill ‘Tear Sky’; the previous five Physical Body Divine Abilities all enhanced various aspects, but ‘Tear Sky’, only destruction.

“Unfortunately, in the short term, I can only exert one strike of ‘Tear Sky’,” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

This is quite normal, Divine Skill ‘Tear Sky’ allows Lin Yuan to deliver a blow that surpasses his own strength by many folds; if he could use it at will, Lin Yuan himself would be afraid.

Among the three Dao-Protecting Secret Skills of the Xuanhuang lineage, the “Xuan Huang One Strike” at a perfect level only allows Lin Yuan a constant six times his battle strength, and it is based on a huge consumption.

While Divine Skill ‘Tear Sky’? Far more than sixty or six hundred times the strength burst.

The battle strength jumping from 300,000 to 400,000 or 500,000 seems to increase by less than one time, but the actual gap in between is unimaginable.

“Regrettably, Divine Skill ‘Tear Sky’ cannot be overlaid with Divine Skill ‘World’, otherwise…” Lin Yuan sighed.

These two Divine Skills are both combative and cannot be fused together.

However, Lin Yuan is already very satisfied. Whether it is Divine Skill ‘World’ or Divine Skill ‘Tear Sky’, their prowess is not fixed, but depends on Lin Yuan himself.

Divine Skill ‘World’ depends on Lin Yuan’s internal world, Divine Skill ‘Tear Sky’ depends on Lin Yuan’s essence of life.

It will increase alongside Lin Yuan becoming stronger.

…

Half a year later.

The Hall Master of Flying Immortal Hall visited again.

“Ha ha ha ha, Master Yun Zhenzi, did you call me here because the Nine Revolutions Golden Pills are all refined?” Flying Immortal Hall’s Hall Master laughed heartily.

Every time Lin Yuan successfully refined a Nine Revolutions Golden Pill, it would cause a heavenly phenomenon, with dense tribulation clouds, from which the Flying Immortal Hall’s Hall Master could infer the quality of the resulting Pills.

“Task fulfilled.”

Lin Yuan stretched out his right hand, and a green gourd appeared in front of the Hall Master of the Flying Immortal Hall.

The Hall Master of the Flying Immortal Hall carefully opened the gourd, pouring out a golden Immortal Pill, and scrutinized it for a while.

“Very good indeed.”

“This Nine Revolutions Golden Pill is definitely among the highest quality of all the Nine Revolutions Golden Pills I have ever seen,” declared the Hall Master of the Flying Immortal Hall, thoroughly satisfied.

He specially half-bartered, half-gifted, using three parts Immortal Source as compensation, requesting Lin Yuan for alchemy, not just assuming that Yun Zhenzi’s alchemy skills were as simple as they appear.

Now it seems, the Hall Master of Flying Immortal Hall clearly bet correctly; just the highest quality Nine Revolutions Golden Pill currently before him was enough to show that Lin Yuan’s alchemy skills surpassed those of an Alchemy Master.

“There are fifty Nine Revolutions Golden Pills in there, I hope the Hall Master will count them.”

Lin Yuan said.

Inside the green gourd were the fifty Nine Revolutions Golden Pills traded to the Hall Master of the Flying Immortal Hall.

In this alchemy session, Lin Yuan produced a total of one hundred and thirty-two pills; aside from these fifty, Lin Yuan secretly took away eighty-two Nine Revolutions Golden Pills.

“Ha ha ha ha, Yun Zhenzi is so straightforward in handing all the Nine Revolutions Golden Pills to me; aren’t you afraid I’ll just turn around and leave?” A smile appeared onView On WordPress

The first is the Ancestor of the Immortal Path.

The second is the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss.

“Hahaha.”

“Thank you, Master Yun Zhenzi, for your trust.”

The Hall Master of the Flying Immortal Hall was also in good spirits, unaware that if he dared to turn around and leave, it would undoubtedly be a situation where even the Ancestral Master could not save him.

The Hall Master of the Flying Immortal Hall thought that Lin Yuan really trusted him.

“This is the tripartite Immortal Source.”

The Hall Master of the Flying Immortal Hall flipped his hand and took out a black wooden box, which hovered in mid-air and came in front of Lin Yuan.

“This…”

Lin Yuan’s heart slightly stirred.

The moment the wooden box appeared, Lin Yuan faintly felt an inexplicable aura, as if it was the origin of everything, the beginning of all things.

Lin Yuan caught the box, just about to open it.

“Master Yun Zhenzi, please don’t open it for now.”

Seeing this, the Hall Master of the Flying Immortal Hall hurriedly reminded: “Once an Immortal Source is revealed, it begins to dissipate; it is best if Master Yun Zhenzi waits until the official use of the Immortal Source to open the box, otherwise it’s a bit of a waste.”

The Immortal Source comes from the Origin of the Immortal Realm, and once it leaves the Primordial Lands, it will irreversibly dissipate.

The wooden box fundamentally helps to isolate the Immortal Source from the outside, stopping its dissipation.

“So that’s how it is.” Lin Yuan nodded, although he had the memories of Yun Zhenzi, he was not very familiar with such rare treasures as the Immortal Source.

…

Next.

The Hall Master of the Flying Immortal Hall further requested Lin Yuan to refine several types of Immortal Pills.

For this Lin Yuan naturally agreed, after all, he wasn’t refining for nothing; Cangwu Immortal City would provide compensation satisfactory to Lin Yuan.

“Is the demand for Immortal Pills by the Immortal City so huge because of the war between immortals and demons?” Lin Yuan asked.

Through conversations with the Hall Master of the Flying Immortal Hall, Lin Yuan subtly realized that Cangwu Immortal City was placing extraordinarily high importance on this war between immortals and demons.

Cangwu Immortal City, as one of the thirty-three Immortal Domains, has experienced countless wars between immortals and demons.

For most Jade Immortals, such wars are a significant threat, with the possibility of falling at the hands of those demons.

But for the Immortal City? Since the first war between immortals and demons began, it has never been heard that any Immortal City was breached by demons.

“This war between immortals and demons is expected to be far more brutal than usual.” The Hall Master of the Flying Immortal Hall hesitated for a while and said in a low voice.

This news has not yet been made public, only giants of the Immortal City like the Hall Master of the Flying Immortal Hall know about it.

If it weren’t for Lin Yuan asking, the Hall Master of the Flying Immortal Hall would not mention it.

After all, the impact is too significant; a normal war between immortals and demons already chills the spines of those Golden Immortals and Jade Immortals; how many Golden and Jade Immortals might die in a far more brutal war?

“Far more?”

Lin Yuan listened.

“Yes.”

“Master Yun Zhenzi should know that the so-called war between immortals and demons is mainly caused by demons from the Demon Abyss invading.”

The Hall Master of the Flying Immortal Hall said: “The reason the demons invade is because part of the consciousness of the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss briefly revives, leading to an endless incursion of demons into the Immortal Realm.”

“In the past, the consciousness of the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss, though it would revive, at most only revives to about ten percent, but in this war between immortals and demons, the consciousness of the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss might revive to fifty or sixty percent.”

The Hall Master of the Flying Immortal Hall spoke gravely.

“Fifty or sixty percent consciousness?”

Lin Yuan’s expression also became solemn.

Such a degree of consciousness revival, the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss might interfere with the Immortal Realm.

Then, the many Immortals of the Immortal Realm, not only are they facing endless demons, but they may also face the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss who is a level twelve ultimate.

However, if the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss intervenes, the Ancestor of the Immortal Path would definitely not just watch.

A direct confrontation between two level twelve ultimates will make this war between immortals and demons intricately complex.

“Let’s hope we can smoothly get through this war between immortals and demons.” The Hall Master of the Flying Immortal Hall sighed and then rose to leave.

“War between immortals and demons?” Lin Yuan sat and contemplated for a while.

The war between immortals and demons doesn’t affect him much; he can simply hide if it becomes too much.

“Let’s see what exactly the Immortal Source is.”

Lin Yuan’s figure disappeared from the spot.

…

Cave Cultivation Area.

Lin Yuan sits cross-legged, a black wooden box quietly hovering in front of him.

“What a peculiar feeling.”

Lin Yuan was amazed, even with the wooden box isolating the inside from outside, he could feel a special sensation.

After observing for a while, Lin Yuan slowly opened the wooden box.

Buzz…

A mysterious aura began to emit.

Lin Yuan looked inside the wooden box, and his expression slightly changed.

“This?!”
